main_text.head: De Iudice ad quem appelletur.
main_text.p: Omnes autem appellationes, ab inferiore Iudice ad superiorem proximum, iusto ordine faciendae sunt.{a} Fallit hoc de Iure Canonico, quo liberum cuiq; relinquitur, etiam omisso medio coram superiori litem provocationis exercere.{b}

{a} Quia lurisdictiones non debent confundi, text. in l. nemo 4. C. de lurisd. omnium iud. Guid. Pap. decis. 436. n. 3. l. 1. §. si quis l. Imperatores in pr. 21. ff. h.t. l. praecipimus 32. C. Eod. Idem in Camera Imperiali receptum est. Ord. Cam. part. 2. tit. 1. §. Es soll auch, & tit. 26. in princ. §. 1.

{b} Quod tamen cum aliqua limitatione accipientum est: nam si proximior medius est inhabilis, vel ratione suspicionis, excommunicationis, vel alterius inhabilitatis: aut si palam & evidenter iustitiam denegauit, siue causam sua sponte ad superiorem remisit: tum eo postposito, recte ad alium superiorem fit provocatio. Ord. Cam. d. part. 2. tit. 29. in princ. Gail. 1. obs. 119. n. 2. Mynsing. Cent. 1. obs. 67. & Cent. 2. obs. 2. Spec. h.t. §. nunc tractemus in princ. c. ad Romanam 2. q. 6. c. si duobus. 7. c. solicitudinem 54. h.t. c. antiqua 23. de priuileg. Mar. d. part. 6. n. 369. Bart. in l. 1. §. 3. ff. h.t. Cuiac. 2. obs. 37.
Imo etiam de Iure ciuili, in Scholaribus. Hi enim ex speciali Impp. priuilegio, recta à quocunq; Iudice inferiore, omisso medio, coram Imperatore appellationes suas interponere possunt,
auth. habita. C. Ne filius pro patr. Marant. in d. part. 6. h.t. n. 372. Pet. Gregor. loc. praal. n. 41.
Quid si quis in Appellatione errauerit: vt puta, cum alium

page.notes: Top citation block and the foot notes are in small type; abbreviations kept as printed. Uncertain: "n. 17" in the first line, and the exact digits in several citations (e.g. "Vant." and "Gail." numbers). The black letter phrase "Es soll auch" is in German black letter and is marked as such. "Quod tamen" carries the b) mark printed after "exercere"; the mark is placed at the start of its note because the printed "b)" sits mid-note. The small ornament after "37." is ignored. Catchword "appel-" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text.
